_comment: Performance budgets for the gallery surface. tools/perf/budget.mjs fails when a number is over its budget.
Values were set from the 2026-11-04 measurement (docs/review/perf-audit-2026-11-04.md, raw numbers in
docs/evidence/perf-2026-11-04/) as the WORSE of two independent runs plus roughly 35% headroom, so the check
passes on build 3b9cd31b3a7b and catches a regression rather than re-stating a wish.
FOUR ROWS FAIL ON PURPOSE, and they are the whole point of the file:
assets.maxFontFileKB and assets.maxCjkFontsPerPageKB are the TARGET of finding P1, not today's 1,802 KiB
and 2,613/2,809 KiB. They go green when an en/ru page stops demanding a CJK glyph and the four CJK faces
scroll.gallery-1443's three frame rows are the TARGET of finding P3 (see _scroll_note).
Everything else passes on build 3b9cd31b3a7b: `node tools/perf/budget.mjs` gives 58/65 within budget, and the
seven breaches are exactly these four subjects. That is the gate that proves P1 and P3 landed.
The device class is phone4x: 390x844 @3, CPU throttled 4x, network 'fast 4G' — Lighthouse's mobile preset.
Numbers are ms unless the key says KB (kibibytes transferred) or pct (percent of frames).
Raise a budget only with a measurement beside it. LOWER it when a fix lands, so a win cannot be given back:
the `after` column below is what each row should become once the ranked fixes are in.
_routes_after_P1_P2: After P1 (the CJK fonts) every bytesKB row should fall by about 2,680 and belongs at 600-1,000;
after P2 (cache headers) every lcpWarm row belongs under 500. After P5, parallel.tbt belongs under 150.
_scroll_note: gallery-1443 IS A TARGET ROW, like the two font rows: it fails on build 3 on purpose, until P3 lands.
It is set where a smooth full grid belongs, not where today's is. Today's is unstable rather than merely slow:
three phone4x runs of the same fling gave 1.8%, 58.7% and 1.8% dropped frames, and phone6x gave 89.3% with a
p50 of 50 ms. That spread is itself the finding — the full grid sits at the edge of the frame budget on a mid
phone, so a little extra load tips it over. After P3 it should look like gallery-progressive does today:
pctDropped under 1 and p99 around 17, stably, and the phone6x run should agree with the phone4x one.
ps119 is NOT a target row: it passes today (0% dropped) and exists to keep the reader from regressing.
_interactions_after_P7: search-type belongs at 300 after P7 (precomputed haystack, memoised hant(), rAF debounce);
lang-menu-open belongs at 120 after P7b (cached item list) and P1b.
